notes.title: Jellies of the Deep is Here!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, I can't believe that [i]Jellies of the Deep[/i] is finally published. Yay! It's been a few years in the making. I hope you will be delighted with this underwater daydream of a game. Relax to soothing music, enjoy the hand-drawn art, drift alongside tiny sea creatures and find one-of-a-kind mystery [i]jellies[/i]. They move about and hide in plain sight... the clues are in their shape, colour and pattern. Oh, and you can name them too. Please enjoy :)

Available for PC and Mac
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3020970/Jellies_of_the_Deep/]Go to store[/url]  |  [url=https://jelliesofthedeep.com]jelliesofthedeep.com[/url]
